ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three circles, the small circle on the left is labeled ⊙A, the large circle in the middle is labeled ⊙B, and the small circle on the right is labeled ⊙C; the centers A, B, C of the three circles are on the same horizontal line. method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram to identify that AZ is the segment from center A of the left small circle to the labeled point Z, and CW is the analogous segment from center C of the right small circle to point W. From the text, read the condition \(\overline{AZ} \cong \overline{CW}\) and the value \(CW=2\). Use the definition of congruent segments: congruent segments have equal lengths. Therefore \(AZ=CW=2\).
